name: Foundry: Slag Run
design_intent:
FOUNDRY: SLAG RUN — THE FOUNDRY circuit's horizontal-CRUSHER gate (tier 2; brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 Foundry row 8). A HORIZONTAL trash-compactor squeezes the mid-lane of the center island B on the validated flagship three-island / one-void shape (the ember sibling of the shipped hazard_yard crusher). The lethal band SHIFTS center<->edges so a standing refuge on B always exists; run with the rhythm to cross, and shove rivals into the closing jaws. Single-family (crusher only), tier 2.

DOCTRINE FIT: (1) LETHAL — a head instakills via kill(&ring_out) only when a body is truly SQUEEZED (no shove). (2) TELEGRAPHY — a long OPEN DWELL (heads parked apart = the clear beat) then a windup SHUDDER + hazard-red FLASH for telegraph_lead 0.55s BEFORE a fast ~0.34s close (period_s 2.6). (3) FAIRNESS — the lethal band SHIFTS: when OPEN the heads sit at B's edges (center x~1750..2310 clear); when CLOSED they meet at center (B's LEFT x1580..1815 and RIGHT x2245..2480 clear) — so a standing refuge on B ALWAYS exists (it moves center<->edges); boosting UP above the head band also clears a close; islands A/C are permanent refuges. (4) CREDIT — a crush kill with no attacker = uncredited self-fall (killer=-1); a rival knocked into the jaws within the 6.0s ring-out window is credited; no environment scorer.

GEOMETRY (symmetric flagship void_is_floor): three flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..900 / B x1580..2480 (CRUSHER, center x2030) / C x3160..4060, all top y1080, separated by 680px void gaps. Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (>=650px recovery sky; outer edges 610px inside side blast lines). Molten open_sky (clouds off, horizon glow).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; Tuning: trampoline apex 270px => ~395px zero-boost drift; max spring drift ~527px; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- DODGE the crusher on B: shuffle with its rhythm (center-safe when open, edges-safe when closed) or boost above the head band. The crusher stays over B leaving refuges and never makes a required gap crossing uncrossable. Verb: DODGE (+ TIME).
- Zero-boost off any island reaches NO other surface across a 680px gap: flight is REQUIRED; the crusher reshapes/times the fight on B.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: a solo horizontal press gating the mid-lane (foundry_first_pour/press_row use VERTICAL presses; foundry_press_gauntlet weaves three). One-line read: 'punch across the compactor island between closes, and shove rivals into the jaws.'
